fit: All fitting positives before 2019-11-13; last20 pre-impression clicked histories; no development target updates.
architecture: SHA256 tokens of category/subcategory/title; masked mean64-dimensional trainable word embeddings; tanh article projection; mean last20 article vectors; linear query projection; L2 normalization; generic trainable empty-history query.
objective: TFRS in-batch softmax; duplicate candidate-ID accidental negatives removed.
selection: One predefined configuration, fixed final epoch. No development-based stopping or model selection.
comparators: Same saved initial content weights, identity query projection
index: FAISS exact IndexFlatIP; strict first_seen < query time; adaptive overretrieval and deterministic boundary ties. Label-free earlier exposures can expand catalog.
evaluation: All 61,894 training-archive development impressions; all positives retained, including unavailable items. Ranking and catalog recall20/100, nDCG100; cold-user, cold-positive, empty-history and stricter fit-unseen-content segments, daily reports.
verification: All-query eligibility/cardinality, persisted-index use, bitwise weights reload, 128 label-independent exhaustive float64 queries per arm (score1e-5/boundary1e-6 tolerances), independent TSV metric audit all groups tolerance1e-10.
final_holdout: Official MINDsmall_dev.zip remains unopened. No final labels or predictions in this increment.
runtime: Native Windows CPU, four intra-op/FAISS threads, one inter-op thread. Actual descendant worker RSS sampled every0.1s; launchers separately recorded.
